FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 526
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 526 as introduced would allow funds in the Alabama 21st Century Fund not needed
to pay obligations of the Alabama 21st Century Authority to be used to pay: (1) project and
project costs, (2) debt service on bonds issued by the Alabama Incentives Financing Authority,
and (3) a one-time transfer of $5 million from the Alabama 21st Century Fund to the
Department of Commerce for the establishment of international offices and to increase rural
development strategy. As of March 2025, the Alabama 21st Century Fund had a balance of $74
million.

FN-PSIVXGR-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 315
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/16/2025
Senate Bill 315 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama 21st Century
Fund (Fund) by an undetermined amount by authorizing these funds, when no longer needed to
pay debt obligations, to pay for project and project costs and debt service on bonds issued by the
Alabama Incentives Financing Authority. In addition, this bill would further increase the
obligations of the Fund by $5 million for a one-time transfer from the Fund to the Alabama
Department of Commerce for the establishment of international offices, enhancement of rural
development strategies, and to cover operational and personnel costs of the Department.
As of March 2025, the balance in the Alabama 21st Century Fund was $74 million.
